import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*x + p[2]*x**3 + p[3]*v + p[4]*v**2 + p[5]/v
            + p[6]*t + p[7]*t*v + p[8]*t*v**2 + p[9]*t/v)
